sql: WITH r AS (SELECT referee, COUNT(*) AS nb_matchs FROM sb.matches GROUP BY referee) SELECT referee, nb_matchs FROM r WHERE nb_matchs = (SELECT MAX(nb_matchs) FROM r) ORDER BY referee

WITH goals AS (SELECT e.match_id, e.team_id, e.player_id, e.minute * 60 + e.second AS secs, 'But' AS type_but FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period <> 5 UNION ALL SELECT e.match_id, e.team_id, e.player_id, e.minute * 60 + e.second AS secs, 'But contre son camp' AS type_but FROM sb.events e WHERE e.type = 'Own Goal Against' AND e.period <> 5) SELECT p.player_name, t.team_name, m.match_date, g.secs AS secondes_depuis_coup_envoi, g.type_but FROM goals g JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id = g.player_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = g.team_id JOIN sb.matches m ON m.match_id = g.match_id WHERE g.secs = (SELECT MIN(secs) FROM goals) ORDER BY p.player_name

WITH g AS (SELECT p.player_name, t.team_name, m.match_date, m.stage, s.statsbomb_xg FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id = e.player_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id JOIN sb.matches m ON m.match_id = e.match_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period <> 5) SELECT * FROM g WHERE statsbomb_xg = (SELECT MIN(statsbomb_xg) FROM g)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.player_id) AS nb_buteurs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period <> 5
SELECT COUNT(*) AS buts_sur_coup_franc_direct FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE s.shot_type = 'Free Kick' AND s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period <> 5

SELECT t.team_name, SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_id = t.team_id THEN m.home_score ELSE m.away_score END) AS buts_marques FROM sb.matches m JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id IN (m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id) WHERE t.team_name = 'France' GROUP BY t.team_name

SELECT COUNT(*) AS buts_prolongations FROM (SELECT e.event_id FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period IN (3, 4) UNION ALL SELECT event_id FROM sb.events WHERE type = 'Own Goal Against' AND period IN (3, 4)) g

SELECT COUNT(*) AS buts_temps_additionnel_2e_mi_temps FROM (SELECT e.event_id FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period = 2 AND e.minute >= 90 UNION ALL SELECT e.event_id FROM sb.events e WHERE e.type = 'Own Goal Against' AND e.period = 2 AND e.minute >= 90) g
SELECT COUNT(*) AS buts_de_la_tete FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE s.body_part = 'Head' AND s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period <> 5
SELECT SUM(home_score + away_score) AS buts_total FROM sb.matches

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c = 'Yellow Card') AS cartons_jaunes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c = 'Second Yellow') AS seconds_jaunes FROM (SELECT COALESCE(details->'foul_committed'->'card'->>'name', details->'bad_behaviour'->'card'->>'name') AS c FROM sb.events WHERE type IN ('Foul Committed', 'Bad Behaviour')) x

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS centres_tentes FROM sb.passes ps JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = ps.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE ps.is_cross AND t.team_name = 'England' AND e.period <> 5 GROUP BY t.team_name

SELECT p.player_name, SUM(s.statsbomb_xg) AS xg_cumule FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id = e.player_id WHERE e.period <> 5 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY xg_cumule DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 5

WITH c AS (SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sb.passes ps JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = ps.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE ps.pass_type = 'Corner' AND e.period <> 5 GROUP BY t.team_name) SELECT team_name, n AS corners FROM c WHERE n = (SELECT MAX(n) FROM c) ORDER BY team_name

WITH r AS (SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS nb_possessions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.reached_final_third) AS nb_dernier_tiers, AVG(p.reached_final_third::int) AS proportion FROM sb.possessions p JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = p.team_id WHERE p.period <> 5 GROUP BY t.team_name) SELECT team_name, nb_possessions, nb_dernier_tiers, proportion FROM r WHERE proportion = (SELECT MAX(proportion) FROM r) ORDER BY team_name

WITH d AS (SELECT p.player_name, t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS dribbles_reussis FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id = e.player_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE e.type = 'Dribble' AND e.details->'dribble'->'outcome'->>'name' = 'Complete' AND e.period <> 5 GROUP BY p.player_name, t.team_name) SELECT player_name, team_name, dribbles_reussis FROM d WHERE dribbles_reussis = (SELECT MAX(dribbles_reussis) FROM d) ORDER BY player_name
SELECT AVG(duration_seconds) AS duree_moyenne_secondes FROM sb.possessions WHERE period <> 5

WITH x AS (SELECT t.team_name, SUM(s.statsbomb_xg) AS xg_total FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE e.period <> 5 GROUP BY t.team_name) SELECT team_name, xg_total FROM x WHERE xg_total = (SELECT MAX(xg_total) FROM x) ORDER BY team_name

WITH f AS (SELECT team_id, COUNT(*) AS fautes FROM sb.events WHERE type = 'Foul Committed' GROUP BY team_id), mj AS (SELECT team_id, COUNT(*) AS matchs FROM (SELECT home_team_id AS team_id FROM sb.matches UNION ALL SELECT away_team_id FROM sb.matches) x GROUP BY team_id), r AS (SELECT t.team_name, f.fautes, mj.matchs, f.fautes::numeric / mj.matchs AS fautes_par_match FROM f JOIN mj ON mj.team_id = f.team_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = f.team_id) SELECT * FROM r WHERE fautes_par_match = (SELECT MAX(fautes_par_match) FROM r)
SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS fautes_commises FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE e.type = 'Foul Committed' AND t.team_name = 'Uruguay' GROUP BY t.team_name

SELECT p.player_name, t.team_name, m.match_date, m.stage, COALESCE(e.details -> 'foul_committed' -> 'card' ->> 'name', e.details -> 'bad_behaviour' -> 'card' ->> 'name') AS carton FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id = e.player_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id JOIN sb.matches m ON m.match_id = e.match_id WHERE e.type IN ('Foul Committed', 'Bad Behaviour') AND COALESCE(e.details -> 'foul_committed' -> 'card' ->> 'name', e.details -> 'bad_behaviour' -> 'card' ->> 'name') IN ('Red Card', 'Second Yellow') ORDER BY m.match_date, p.player_name

SELECT th.team_name AS equipe_1, ta.team_name AS equipe_2, m.match_date, m.stage, m.home_score, m.away_score, m.home_score + m.away_score AS total_buts FROM sb.matches m JOIN sb.teams th ON th.team_id = m.home_team_id JOIN sb.teams ta ON ta.team_id = m.away_team_id WHERE m.home_score + m.away_score = (SELECT MAX(home_score + away_score) FROM sb.matches) ORDER BY m.match_date
SELECT COUNT(*) AS matchs_joues FROM sb.matches m JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id IN (m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id) WHERE t.team_name = 'Croatia'

interpretation: score final egal, tirs au but compris
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS nuls_score_final, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sb.events e WHERE e.match_id = m.match_id AND e.period = 5)) AS nuls_sans_tirs_au_but FROM sb.matches m WHERE m.home_score = m.away_score

WITH c AS (SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS buts FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id = e.player_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period <> 5 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name) SELECT * FROM c WHERE buts = (SELECT MAX(buts) FROM c)

WITH a AS (SELECT p.player_name, t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS passes_decisives FROM sb.passes ps JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = ps.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id = e.player_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE ps.goal_assist AND e.period <> 5 GROUP BY p.player_name, t.team_name) SELECT player_name, team_name, passes_decisives FROM a WHERE passes_decisives = (SELECT MAX(passes_decisives) FROM a) ORDER BY player_name

WITH c AS (SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS passes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.outcome IS NULL) AS reussies, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.outcome IS NULL)::numeric / COUNT(*) AS taux_reussite FROM sb.passes ps JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = ps.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name) SELECT * FROM c WHERE taux_reussite = (SELECT MAX(taux_reussite) FROM c)

WITH t AS (SELECT home_team_id AS team_id, away_score AS ga FROM sb.matches UNION ALL SELECT away_team_id, home_score FROM sb.matches), c AS (SELECT tm.team_name, SUM(t.ga) AS buts_encaisses, COUNT(*) AS matchs, SUM(t.ga)::numeric / COUNT(*) AS buts_encaisses_par_match FROM t JOIN sb.teams tm ON tm.team_id = t.team_id GROUP BY tm.team_id, tm.team_name) SELECT * FROM c WHERE buts_encaisses = (SELECT MIN(buts_encaisses) FROM c)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS buts_contre_son_camp FROM sb.events WHERE type = 'Own Goal Against' AND period <> 5
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_matchs FROM sb.matches
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_remplacements FROM sb.events WHERE type = 'Substitution'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS matchs_aux_tirs_au_but FROM sb.events WHERE period = 5

WITH g AS (SELECT e.period FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period <> 5 UNION ALL SELECT period FROM sb.events WHERE type = 'Own Goal Against' AND period <> 5) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE period = 1) AS buts_premiere_periode, COUNT(*) AS buts_total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE period = 1)::numeric / COUNT(*) AS part_premiere_periode FROM g

SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(ps.event_id) AS passes_decisives FROM sb.players p LEFT JOIN sb.events e ON e.player_id = p.player_id AND e.period <> 5 LEFT JOIN sb.passes ps ON ps.event_id = e.event_id AND ps.goal_assist WHERE p.player_name ILIKE '%Eden%Hazard%' GROUP BY p.player_name

SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(ps.event_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.goal_assist) AS passes_decisives FROM sb.players p LEFT JOIN sb.events e ON e.player_id = p.player_id AND e.type = 'Pass' LEFT JOIN sb.passes ps ON ps.event_id = e.event_id WHERE p.player_name ILIKE '%Hazard%' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY passes_decisives DESC

SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(ps.event_id) AS passes_reussies FROM sb.players p LEFT JOIN sb.events e ON e.player_id = p.player_id AND e.period <> 5 LEFT JOIN sb.passes ps ON ps.event_id = e.event_id AND ps.outcome IS NULL WHERE p.player_name ILIKE '%Luka Modri%' GROUP BY p.player_name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS passes_en_profondeur_reussies FROM sb.passes WHERE is_through_ball AND outcome IS NULL

WITH c AS (SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS passes_reussies FROM sb.passes ps JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = ps.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id = e.player_id WHERE ps.outcome IS NULL GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name) SELECT * FROM c WHERE passes_reussies = (SELECT MAX(passes_reussies) FROM c)

WITH b AS (SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.player_id) AS buteurs_differents FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period <> 5 GROUP BY t.team_name) SELECT team_name, buteurs_differents FROM b WHERE buteurs_differents = (SELECT MAX(buteurs_differents) FROM b) ORDER BY team_name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS penalties_tires FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE s.shot_type = 'Penalty' AND e.period <> 5
SELECT COUNT(*) AS penalties_transformes FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE s.shot_type = 'Penalty' AND s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period <> 5

WITH t AS (SELECT home_team_id AS team_id, away_score AS ga FROM sb.matches UNION ALL SELECT away_team_id, home_score FROM sb.matches), c AS (SELECT tm.team_name, SUM(t.ga) AS buts_encaisses FROM t JOIN sb.teams tm ON tm.team_id = t.team_id GROUP BY tm.team_id, tm.team_name) SELECT * FROM c WHERE buts_encaisses = (SELECT MAX(buts_encaisses) FROM c)

interpretation: part moyenne du temps de possession par match
sql: WITH pm AS (SELECT match_id, team_id, SUM(duration_seconds) AS d FROM sb.possessions WHERE period <> 5 GROUP BY match_id, team_id), sh AS (SELECT team_id, d::numeric / SUM(d) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id) AS part FROM pm), r AS (SELECT t.team_name, AVG(sh.part) AS part_possession_moyenne FROM sh JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = sh.team_id GROUP BY t.team_name) SELECT team_name, part_possession_moyenne FROM r WHERE part_possession_moyenne = (SELECT MAX(part_possession_moyenne) FROM r) ORDER BY team_name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS possessions_avec_tir FROM sb.possessions po JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = po.team_id WHERE t.team_name = 'Belgium' AND po.produced_shot AND po.period <> 5

WITH t AS (SELECT home_team_id AS team_id, home_score AS gf, away_score AS ga FROM sb.matches WHERE stage = 'Group Stage' UNION ALL SELECT away_team_id, away_score, home_score FROM sb.matches WHERE stage = 'Group Stage') SELECT COUNT(*) AS equipes_sans_victoire FROM (SELECT team_id FROM t GROUP BY team_id HAVING SUM((gf > ga)::int) = 0) x
SELECT m.stadium, m.match_date FROM sb.matches m WHERE m.stage = 'Final'

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS nb_tirs, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.outcome IN ('Goal', 'Saved')) AS nb_tirs_cadres, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.outcome IN ('Goal', 'Saved')) / COUNT(*) AS pourcentage_cadres FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE t.team_name = 'France' AND e.period <> 5 GROUP BY t.team_name

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.outcome IS NULL) AS passes_reussies, COUNT(*) AS passes_tentees, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.outcome IS NULL)::numeric / COUNT(*) AS taux_reussite FROM sb.passes ps JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = ps.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE t.team_name = 'Spain' AND e.period <> 5 GROUP BY t.team_name

WITH c AS (SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS tirs_cadres FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id = e.player_id WHERE s.outcome IN ('Goal', 'Saved') AND e.period <> 5 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name) SELECT * FROM c WHERE tirs_cadres = (SELECT MAX(tirs_cadres) FROM c)

WITH c AS (SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS tirs_concedes FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.matches m ON m.match_id = e.match_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = CASE WHEN e.team_id = m.home_team_id THEN m.away_team_id ELSE m.home_team_id END WHERE e.period <> 5 GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name) SELECT * FROM c WHERE tirs_concedes = (SELECT MAX(tirs_concedes) FROM c)

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS nb_tirs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE t.team_name = 'Croatia' AND e.period <> 5 GROUP BY t.team_name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_tirs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.matches m ON m.match_id = e.match_id WHERE m.stage = 'Final' AND e.period <> 5

WITH x AS (SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS tirs_hors_surface FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id WHERE e.period <> 5 AND e.loc_x IS NOT NULL AND e.loc_y IS NOT NULL AND NOT (e.loc_x >= 102 AND e.loc_y BETWEEN 18 AND 62) GROUP BY t.team_name) SELECT team_name, tirs_hors_surface FROM x WHERE tirs_hors_surface = (SELECT MAX(tirs_hors_surface) FROM x) ORDER BY team_name

SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS tirs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON p.player_id = e.player_id WHERE p.player_name ILIKE '%Mbapp%' AND e.period <> 5 GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name

SELECT COUNT(*)::numeric / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sb.matches) AS tirs_par_match, COUNT(*)::numeric / (2 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sb.matches)) AS tirs_par_equipe_par_match FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE e.period <> 5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (l -> 'player' ->> 'id')::int) AS joueurs_differents_en_onze_de_depart FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = e.team_id, jsonb_array_elements(e.details -> 'tactics' -> 'lineup') AS l WHERE e.type = 'Starting XI' AND t.team_name = 'France'

WITH f AS (SELECT * FROM sb.matches WHERE stage = 'Final'), tab AS (SELECT e.team_id, COUNT(*) AS buts FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.shots s ON s.event_id = e.event_id JOIN f ON f.match_id = e.match_id WHERE e.period = 5 AND s.outcome = 'Goal' GROUP BY e.team_id) SELECT t.team_name AS vainqueur, f.home_score, f.away_score FROM f JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = CASE WHEN f.home_score > f.away_score THEN f.home_team_id WHEN f.away_score > f.home_score THEN f.away_team_id ELSE (SELECT team_id FROM tab ORDER BY buts DESC LIMIT 1) END

WITH tab AS (SELECT e.match_id, e.team_id, COUNT(*) AS buts FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id WHERE e.period = 5 AND s.outcome = 'Goal' GROUP BY e.match_id, e.team_id), w AS (SELECT match_id, team_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY buts DESC) AS r FROM tab) SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS seances_gagnees FROM w JOIN sb.teams t ON t.team_id = w.team_id WHERE w.r = 1 GROUP BY t.team_name ORDER BY seances_gagnees DESC, t.team_name

WITH r AS (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'Russia'), rm AS (SELECT m.match_id, CASE WHEN m.home_team_id = r.team_id THEN m.home_score ELSE m.away_score END AS gf, CASE WHEN m.home_team_id = r.team_id THEN m.away_score ELSE m.home_score END AS ga FROM sb.matches m JOIN r ON r.team_id IN (m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id)), tab AS (SELECT e.match_id, SUM((e.team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM r) AND s.outcome = 'Goal')::int) AS pour, SUM((e.team_id <> (SELECT team_id FROM r) AND s.outcome = 'Goal')::int) AS contre FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.shots s ON s.event_id = e.event_id WHERE e.period = 5 GROUP BY e.match_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rm.gf > rm.ga) AS victoires_au_score, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rm.gf > rm.ga OR (rm.gf = rm.ga AND tab.pour > tab.contre)) AS victoires_avec_tirs_au_but FROM rm LEFT JOIN tab ON tab.match_id = rm.match_id
